name: Elena Rodriguez Garcia
bio:
Elena's journey into motorsport was a second act, a pivot from a successful but unfulfilling career in logistics. After years of managing complex supply chains, she realized her true passion lay in the precision and teamwork of racing. She enrolled in evening courses on motorsport management, devouring knowledge about race strategy, team dynamics, and the technical intricacies of the sport. 

Elena's approach to her role as Head of Operations is methodical and detail-oriented. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. While her technical knowledge is still developing, she compensates with exceptional organizational skills and a relentless drive to optimize processes. What sets Elena apart is her unwavering belief in the potential of her team and her dedication to creating a supportive and high-performing culture, and her quick learning in the field.

Ambitious to bring the team to the top, she focuses on the small things and is not afraid to ask questions. She sees the position as an opportunity to bring the team to the top of the ranks.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Elena has a warm smile and a focused gaze, conveying both intelligence and determination.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a collection of inspirational quotes related to teamwork and perseverance that she shares with the team.
Insists on a 'no blame' policy during post-race debriefs, focusing instead on learning and improvement.
